question: Which strategies earn in which market regimes, and does a regime router that enables each strategy only where it earned in development beat always-on allocation on an untouched holdout?

regime_classifier.input: BTCUSDT daily closes, only bars closed before the decision day (causal)

trend.UP: close > SMA100 and SMA100 > SMA100 twenty days earlier
trend.DOWN: close < SMA100 and SMA100 < SMA100 twenty days earlier

volatility.HIGH: 20-day realized vol of daily log returns > median of its trailing 365 daily values

regime_classifier.cells: TREND x VOL = 6 cells; nothing else, no tuning

strategy_streams_stress_costs.BOOK_A: frozen BOOK_A_ALT_RM + BOOK_A_RISK_DEFAULT, $250, daily PnL (existing simulator)
strategy_streams_stress_costs.BOOK_B: frozen BENCH_AB_R2 Book B quiet router, $250, daily PnL (existing simulator)
strategy_streams_stress_costs.BTC_SMA200_LONG: 1x long BTC from the next day when the prior daily close > SMA200, else flat; 12 bps per switch; funding paid by longs
strategy_streams_stress_costs.S115_A: new-listing short (protocol s115), $25 notional per trade, max 5 concurrent, attributed to the entry-day regime

split.note: Book A/B were designed by earlier project work on 2024-08..2026 data, so the 2025-2026 window is contaminated diagnostic, not a clean holdout. True out-of-sample = frozen paper-forward from 2026-11-01.

router_rule: enable a stream in a cell iff in development: >= 100 days (daily streams) or >= 50 trades (S115_A); mean > 0; weekly-aggregated t >= 2.9 (one-sided Bonferroni 0.05/24 cells); and mean > 0 separately in 2023 and in 2024

risk_layer.per_stream_scaling: daily streams scaled to 10% annualized vol of the sleeve using own trailing 60-day realized vol, capped at 1.0x
risk_layer.S115_A: $25 per trade, at most 5 concurrent positions ($125 gross = sleeve capital); new listings skipped while full
risk_layer.portfolio_brake: if portfolio equity is >10% below its peak on $500, all exposures are halved until a new peak

outputs: atlas table (stream x cell, development and holdout), router cell map, holdout comparison, $/day at $250-per-book scale
no_parameter_search: regime definitions, thresholds and router rule are fixed here; changes require a new protocol id
revision_note: v1.1 frozen before any S116 result, after external review: one S115 variant only (S115_A, chosen before seeing S115 results), explicit $500 capital in 4 equal sleeves, S115 concurrency cap, Bonferroni-strength router threshold, 2025-2026 renamed diagnostic.
capital: $500 total in 4 equal sleeves of $125 (BOOK_A, BOOK_B, BTC_SMA200_LONG, S115_A); each sleeve max 1x gross of its capital; a disabled sleeve holds cash
diagnostic_gates_all_required: router diagnostic PnL > always-on equal-allocation of the same streams (same risk layer)
router diagnostic month-block bootstrap 95% lower bound of mean daily PnL > 0
decision_meaning: PASS only authorizes a frozen paper-forward challenger; it is not proof of edge
